entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may support A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both.

entities.name: R99 QoS Parameters
entities.description: R99 QoS parameter values of a PDP context that must be included when mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb or Iu mode is supported.

entities.name: PDP Context
entities.description: Packet Data Protocol context for which QoS parameters are negotiated.

relations.description: Network shall include R99 QoS parameter values when supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb or Iu mode.
R99 QoS parameters are associated with a PDP context.
Network behavior is conditioned on UE support for A/Gb mode or Iu mode.
